name: Xtreme P192 wireless speaker
description: This is an XTREME P192 Portable Bluetooth Speaker in a camouflage pattern, featuring a 12W output and IPX6 waterproofing.It includes RGB LED lights that sync with the music and offers 4–8 hours of playtime.The speaker supports Bluetooth v5.3, USB, AUX, TF card, and FM radio playback modes.
